highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 combines Skia m156 with GTK4 GPU rendering, Uno 7 support and font-lifetime fixes.
highlights_body: Linux NoDependencies font discovery returns, Android continuous rendering follows display refresh, and native rendering fixes improve paths, clipping and text. Upgrading also requires attention to GTK4 coordinates, Uno controls, Apple and Tizen minimums, and malformed text buffers.

breaking.title: Choose GTK4 logical or physical paint coordinates
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical paint coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing pixels. RawInfo remains physical, and GTK input coordinates remain logical. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for SKGLArea.

breaking.title: Move Uno integrations to Uno 7 and .NET 10
breaking.body: The non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; old platform/runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration are retired. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, drops RaiseOnUnsupported and uses a CPU fallback with null GRContext on non-Windows targets. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usage and use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is needed. The Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed.

breaking.title: Raise Apple deployment targets
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS or Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly and retain any higher managed or framework minimum. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 baseline introduced during this release line.

breaking.title: Upgrade Tizen applications to Tizen 10
breaking.body: The Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64 and arm64. Tizen 8/9 and former 32-bit build paths are no longer supported. Move applications and manifests to Tizen 10; custom native builds require the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2.

breaking.title: Pass well-formed encoded text buffers
breaking.body: Shared font text validation now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative byte lengths and ArgumentException for odd GlyphID byte counts before interop. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs when counting, converting, measuring or building text paths. Encoded BreakText overloads return bytes; string and char-span overloads return UTF-16 code units.

breaking.title: Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the source array. Pass an in-bounds length rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

breaking.title: Rebuild custom WebGPU archives
breaking.body: Newer WebAssembly consumers require libSkiaSharp.a to include emdawnwebgpu's C++ support. Rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; pre-change and GPU-disabled archives do not satisfy this link contract. The port is no longer compiled on the application's final link line. Matching JavaScript glue remains a consumer link input, and this release line retains the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path.

breaking.title: Pass one encoded unit to GetUnicodeCharacterCode
breaking.body: StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width instead of UTF-16 string length. Pass ASCII for UTF-8, a BMP character for UTF-16 or one Unicode code point for UTF-32; use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Previously accepted multi-character UTF-32 strings are rejected rather than silently returning the first character's code.

breaking.title: Use supported Windows native targets
breaking.body: The fork-specific WinRT native target is retired. Use the supported desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK or NanoServer paths rather than relying on that legacy target.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without adding C bridge exports or changing core managed API signatures. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.100 package band still bundles HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

SKGLArea adds GTK-owned GPU rendering with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop and IgnorePixelScaling. Invalidate through GTK's QueueRender; automatic rendering defaults off. Raster drawing also corrects Cairo pixel-storage disposal and dirty notification.

Linux NoDependencies assets again discover fonts from /usr/share/fonts/ by default without requiring fontconfig. Bundled Linux HarfBuzz function calls stay within their own implementation, preventing incompatible system-library calls after GTK initializes.

Corrects clipped convex-path rasterization, reflected zero-length hairline caps, text-atlas selection and serialized glyph replay validation. Graphite fixes cover inverse fills, stroke bounds, clip keys and alpha-to-RGBx readback; GLES no longer advertises an invalid BGRA upload combination.

Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. Failed raster-pipeline construction no longer leaves executable partial branches, and transformed child failures propagate instead of running an incomplete pipeline. Region storage also accounts for subdivided conic edges to avoid undersized buffers.

StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode decodes one unit of the requested encoding: ASCII for UTF-8, a BMP character for UTF-16, or one Unicode code point for UTF-32. Use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. GetString now reports null byte arrays with ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException.

Automatic GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows Choreographer display callbacks instead of buffer-swap throughput. Explicit RequestRender calls remain independent, and drawing stays on the GL worker; this is not a guarantee of presentation timing.

DWriteCore custom-font data is released after the last typeface clone is disposed. Windows EGL teardown unbinds its own current context so removed SKGLView panels can be collected. Cached WGL pointers retain their OpenGL module, and native cleanup corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership.

Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose the borrowed stream: the caller remains responsible for that stream's lifetime.

Native callbacks now use one-byte Skia booleans and four-byte HarfBuzz hb_bool_t values while public managed delegates remain bool-based. This corrects the callback ABI, including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns and false-returning HarfBuzz callbacks.

Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation while preserving decoding and invalid-input behavior.

.NET 11+ selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives, while .NET 9/10 retains 3.1.56 and .NET 8 retains 3.1.34 in this line. Newer WebGPU assets include the C++ port in libSkiaSharp.a, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources; matching JavaScript glue remains a link input.

Refreshes WinUI's ANGLE engine to chromium/8118 and aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 without changing the declared Windows runtime minimum. AnyCPU native asset selection uses portable win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64 RIDs instead of legacy win10-* identifiers.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, moved WebGPU C++ support into native archives and rebuilt the Uno views for Uno 7.
contributor_summaries.akoeplinger: Corrected GitOps author mentions and disabled dependency automation on the Azure DevOps mirror.
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Corrected Linux HarfBuzz symbol binding and made Blazor CPU sample capture wait for the first canvas paint.
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Reviewed contextual PoliCheck findings and clarified workflow and sample wording without changing behavior.
contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Removed unused sample files to reduce irrelevant automated scanning findings.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11: Adds Uno 7 support, display-paced Android rendering, font and stream lifetime fixes, and corrected callback ABI widths. Apple native minimums become macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS or Mac Catalyst 15, alongside stricter text-buffer validation.
preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. GTK4 painting defaults to physical pixels, WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 in the 14.4.0.100 package band. It reduces UTF-32 and feature-string allocations, corrects callback boolean widths, selects runtime-matched WebAssembly assets and adopts the new Apple and Tizen deployment floors.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: GTK4 painting defaults to physical pixels; enable IgnorePixelScaling for logical coordinates. WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11.headline: The release candidate adds Uno 7 support and corrects font and stream lifetimes.
v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11.body: It also paces Android rendering to display refresh, tightens input validation and corrects callback ABI widths and Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption. Apple libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15.

v4.156.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 adds further path, clip and text rendering fixes after the release candidate.
v4.156.0.body: The stable cut improves clipped convex-path rasterization, reflected hairline caps and glyph-atlas selection, and corrects Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback. Managed API signatures are unchanged from the release candidate.
